citations.description: Fixture only checks .rebar absence, not list_tickets() == []
list_tickets() == [] check is here in a test, not in the fixture

findings.criterion: The template fixture asserts it is virgin (no tickets, no `<repo>/.rebar/`).
findings.detail: The `_rebar_repo_template` fixture in tests/interfaces/conftest.py (lines 89-92) only asserts `not (repo / ".rebar").exists()`. It does NOT call `rebar.list_tickets()` or otherwise assert that the template carries no tickets. The AC requires the fixture itself to assert both conditions. The `list_tickets() == []` check exists only in the separate `test_template_stays_virgin` test (test_rebar_repo_isolation.py:207-216), not in the fixture.
